verdicts.claim: the doubles substrate is exactly the organism’s own answer: on every held-out case of every live organ, its score and label equal what germinate.mjs gives
verdicts.saw: JavaScript doubles gave the organism’s own score and label on 6885 of 6885 held cases across 4 live organs

verdicts.claim: two more engines agree byte for byte: exact integers in millionths and a hand-assembled WebAssembly module (a valid, self-contained module) give the organism’s own score and label on every one of those cases — the same structure, three different engines
verdicts.saw: int 6885/6885 identical; wasm 6885/6885 identical; the WebAssembly module is 127 bytes, valid: true

verdicts.claim: single precision agrees too, bar a counted few: it gives the reference label on all but at most 1% of the cases, and every disagreement sits within one single-precision step of the line, where single precision cannot tell the score from the threshold
verdicts.saw: single precision differed from the reference label on 0 of 6885 cases (0.000%), every one within a single-precision step of the line: true
